Nina (AE): QuantaLogistics signed off on a 2-week POC. They want: streaming SDK -> function/tool calls for realtime moderation and a structured JSON envelope for downstream ranking. Demo requested Fri 9am ET. Need SE + runtime + security + pricing notes.
Omar (SE): I'll own the runbook. Quick Qs: do they need VPC/Dedicated for the trial (KMS/SAML) or will hosted with SOC2 attestation do? Also what's their latency SLO and largest document size?
Leah (Runtime): They reported docs up to ~28k tokens; SLO target for interactive paths is ~300ms tail. Their infra also terminates long SSE connections after ~70s. We should provide websocket fallback + heartbeat + chunked uploads for large contexts.
Ibrahim (Security): From initial questionnaire: they want SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS, and ability to ship audit logs to their Splunk instance. Hosted path works only if they accept our SOC2 attestation and no external KMS. If they insist on KMS/SAML, we should run the POC on Dedicated. Ask for SAML metadata and the KMS key policy snippet.
Claire (Finance): Ballpark for trial: 2-week Dedicated-style trial (reserve 1 x high-memory GPU, ~5 vGPU-days) -> offer $6.5k trial credit + hands-on support. Production Dedicated baseline quote ~ $17k/mo depending on autoscale. Tool/function invocation charge = $0.002/call + per-token inference fees.
Omar (SE): Leah, can you paste a minimal handshake (prefer SSE, fallback ws), a tiny node ws fallback, and an example of a tool.call event plus the structured JSON envelope we want their parser to expect? I'll hand that to their infra/security.
Leah (Runtime): Sure. Keep ephemeral creds short TTL for demo. Handshake (curl /sse preferred):

```
curl -X POST https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/start \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-stream-8b","max_tokens":32768,"interactive":true,"prefer":"sse;fallback=websocket","chunked_upload":true}'
```

Leah (Runtime): Websocket fallback (node):

```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/ws',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer <EPHEMERAL>'}});
ws.on('open',()=>{ ws.send(JSON.stringify({model:'rwd-stream-8b',max_tokens:32768})); });
ws.on('message',m=>console.log('evt',m));
setInterval(()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'heartbeat'})),20000);
```

Leah (Runtime): Tool call event when assistant invokes moderation:

```
event: message
data: {"role":"assistant","type":"tool.call","tool":"moderation","args":{"text":"<excerpt>"},"trace_id":"ql-001"}
```

Leah (Runtime): Structured JSON envelope example (final assistant content):

```
{"envelope_version":"1.0","session_id":"sess-123","response":{"choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"content":{"type":"structured","schema":"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"action\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"reason\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"score\":{\"type\":\"number\"}}}","value":{"action":"allow","reason":"no-issue","score":0.01}}}]}}
```

Omar (SE): For client reliability guidance: recommend client window=8 in-flight chunks, heartbeat=20s, reconnect exponential backoff with full jitter. For large docs use chunked_upload so the runtime can prefix-cache and reduce cost. Server recs: prefix KV cache enabled, auto-batch target=32 to keep p50 low, preemptive KV warming for repeated shipments.
Claire (Finance): For the deck show example math: if they run 3k moderation calls/day at avg 150 tokens/call => token cost + 3k*$0.002 = $6/day in tool fees. Add monthly extrapolation.
Ibrahim (Security): Action items: get SAML metadata XML, KMS policy snippet, and confirm whether they require event streaming of audit logs to Splunk (we can push via HTTP collector on Dedicated/Private). Also note: ephemeral token usage for demos is allowed but must be short TTL and logged.
token-bot: ephemeral token issued (valid 02:00:00)  token id: tok-ql-demo-1933 (demo only)
Nina (AE): Demo scheduled Fri 9am ET. Omar, Leah, Ibrahim attending. Quanta asked we push a 10k+ token doc and trigger moderation + structured envelope in front of their reranker. Please confirm readiness by Thu EOD.
Omar (SE): Confirmed. I'll draft the 1-page runbook (ephemeral creds flow, handshake + ws fallback, chunked upload example, structured envelope, proxy tips, escalation contacts) and share with their infra.
Leah (Runtime): I'll build a tiny docker image with websocket fallback + chunked-uploader and a small load script to stream a 10k doc (image: docker.pkg.redwood/quanta-demo:rev3). Will post run instructions and image link by Thu.
Ibrahim (Security): I'll email Quanta security lead, request SAML metadata & KMS policy, and ask about Splunk collector details.
Nina (AE): Thanks team  high priority. If anything blocks (proxy or rate limits) ping me and we'll escalate to eng-sre. :rocket:
